# H071 — The protein half of P4-1: a wild-type and mutant amino-acid window can be built for essentially every missense allele in the record set from hgvs_p plus the Ensembl protein sequence, with no extra identifier lookup

**Step:** [step-1](../README.md) — Can every allele in scope be expressed as one normalized record that every model class can read — genomic change, transcript, protein change, DNA window, protein window — with lineage?
**Status:** supported  |  **Confidence:** 0.90  |  **Revisions:** 2
**Gene:** BUB1B  |  **Path:** zoo-record-windows

## The claim

The protein half of P4-1: a wild-type and mutant amino-acid window can be built for essentially every missense allele in the record set from hgvs_p plus the Ensembl protein sequence, with no extra identifier lookup

**Prediction if true.** At least 98 percent of the 15,620 missense_variant records get a complete window pair, where complete means the Ensembl sequence for the ENSP accession hgvs_p names was fetched and its residue at the named position equals the reference residue hgvs_p spells

**What would refute it.** Fewer than 90 percent of missense records get a complete window pair

## Evidence

| # | Direction | Strength | Kind | Observation | Source |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 174 | supports | 0.90 | measurement | 15,592 of 15,620 missense records (99.821 percent) got a complete wild-type and mutant amino-acid window from hgvs_p plus the Ensembl protein sequence, with no identifier lookup beyond the ENSP accession the spelling already carries | `docs/iteration4/step-1/methodology/141-a-window-for-every-substitution-the-spelling-actually-describes.md` |
| 175 | supports | 0.80 | measurement | Zero residue mismatches over 15,592 alleles: the reference residue hgvs_p spells equals the Ensembl sequence at that position every time, so no window was built on a disagreeing isoform | `docs/iteration4/step-1/methodology/141-a-window-for-every-substitution-the-spelling-actually-describes.md` |
| 176 | neutral | 0.20 | measurement | The 28 missense records with no window are all delins spellings that replace two or more residues, so a one-residue substitution model has nothing to score there | `docs/iteration4/step-1/methodology/141-a-window-for-every-substitution-the-spelling-actually-describes.md` |
